parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp in UTC. Unit: milliseconds.

> If the query time range is less than 1 hour, the data within 1 hour before the end time is returned.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description:
The performance monitoring metrics. You can specify multiple metrics in a single request. Separate multiple metrics with commas (,).
> For more information about performance monitoring metrics, see [Instance monitoring](~~186703~~).

parameters.name: PeriodMultiple
parameters.description: The multiplier for the monitoring data collection period. For example, the default data collection period for each resource monitoring metric is 1 minute. If you set the period multiplier to 2, the data collection period for the current resource monitoring metric is 2 minutes.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp in UTC. Unit: milliseconds.
